paragraphs: (Zechariah son of Berekhyah, [Zechariah 1:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Zechariah.1.1).) Rabbi Elazar bar Berekhyah: [Sanhedrin 94b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.94b.8).
Rabbi Levi bar Berekhyah: [Tanchuma Buber, Bechukotai 7:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Midrash_Tanchuma_Buber%2C_Bechukotai.7.1).[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Berakhot explicitly gives Rav Huna. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1048&lang=en) points to the Eikhah teaching of Rabbi Hillel. Tanchuma Buber calls Rabbi Levi “ben Berekhyah” in the reading where Hyman gives “bar Berekhyah.” He interprets the mountains in the story of Jephthah’s daughter as the court.
